     - Full 16-scenario SPAN risk array modeling simultaneous underlying price shifts ($\pm 3\sigma$, $\pm 2\sigma$, $\pm 1\sigma$, $0$) and implied volatility shocks ($\pm 4\%, 0\%$).

  2. **Extreme Value Theory (EVT) Expected Shortfall Desk (`TC-RISK-02`):**
     - Tail risk estimation using Peaks-Over-Threshold (POT) Generalized Pareto Distribution (GPD).
     - Parametric VaR (99%), Historical VaR, and EVT Expected Shortfall ($\text{ES}_{99\%} / \text{ES}_{99.9\%}$) with shape parameter $\xi = 0.32$ flagging heavy Fréchet tail risk.
     - Historical tail crisis shock benchmarks (Lok Sabha Election Day crash, COVID-19 circuit breaker, Lehman collapse, overnight geopolitical gaps).
  3. **Pre-Trade Gatekeeper Validator & Veto Interceptor (`TC-RISK-02`, `TC-RISK-04`):**
     - Sub-millisecond pre-trade order interceptor vetting margin sufficiency, leverage tiers (Optimal, Moderate, Caution, Throttled, Breached), and circuit price bands before dispatch.
     - Automatic order rejection with detailed margin deficit diagnostics and suggested max order quantity.
  4. **Interactive Pre-Trade Risk & Stress Desk Modal (`TC-RISK-03`, `TC-RISK-04`):**
     - High-tech cyber-dark UI (`RiskCockpitModal.tsx` / `PreTradeRiskModal.tsx`) featuring 4 specialized workspaces: SPAN Heatmap, Pre-Trade Gatekeeper Simulator, EVT Fat-Tail Distribution, and Circuit Breaker & 1-Click Unwind Plan.
